name: ditto-rust
description: Ditto Rust SDK assistance — Linux and macOS apps with Tokio: Cargo and toolchain setup, connecting, authentication, transports, subscriptions, DQL execution, observers bridged into async code, transactions, attachments, presence, support bundles, and testing. Covers Ditto SDK 4.14.x (LTS), 5.0.x, 5.1.x and 5.2.0

interface.shortDescription: Build and troubleshoot Ditto Rust apps with Tokio on Linux and macOS.
defaultPrompt: Add Ditto to this Tokio service with an observer feeding an async task.
Generate a runnable Cargo project that syncs a collection with Ditto.
Diagnose why my Rust app fails to link or aborts after opening Ditto.
